notes.title: MINOR UPDATE - Localizations!
notes.notes:
Update: 5 other languages have been added to the game!
Aside from English (the default language), you can now play the game in the following 5 languages:

 Chinese （简体中文）
 Japanese (日本語)
 Korean　(한국어)
 German (Deutsch)
 Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)

You can select the different languages from the dropdown list on the top left corner of the Main Menu screen.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Get Your ‘Cheeves Together! Achievement & Leaderboard Update!
notes.notes:
Surprise! The achievement and leaderboard update for Get Your Sheep together is here!

Explore the emotional rage-inducing landscape once more to obtain 16 new achievements! We hope you enjoy trying to obtain them as much as we did creating them 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41944610/31b74f21c6798f1ec7416d20785530427bae2535.gif
Behold, the bottom-right pop-ups! (or wherever you place your achievement pop-ups)

In addition to achievements, we’ve added a global leaderboard to test your fastest sheep-collecting time and track how many sheep you’ve collected in your lifetime. How do you fare against your friends? Or perhaps, you seek to be the top birb in handling your emotions? Whatever the case may be, we’ve now got the stat-tracks to prove it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41944610/a4ebf6724109732941de478e3a7082f532da72bc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41944610/7725ded8124317fbaef6714f6482ca1260e852fb.png

Lastly, the update comes with some bugs squashed for a cleaner update release. The complete list can be seen below! If there are other bugs found in the update or not addressed, let us know through Discord, Steam Discussion or through the in-game report function! Rest assured we do our best to check these and further improve the game experience for everyone. ːsteamthumbsupː

Where have we been?

Get Your Sheep Together is our first efforts as a studio to create a game, and we’ve learnt a lot about the development process from it! 

We’re hard at work to create the next step of our journey, something that brings the fun to more people! If you want to follow along, check out our socials below for the latest news and updates from us!

Discord: https://discord.gg/bBKyRTrZ7a
Website: https://www.thedoodlepeople.com/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheDoodlePeople
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thedoodlepeople.studio/

Thank you for supporting us and letting our little game bring some joy (or frustration?) into your life. 

Sheep you soon!

The Doodle People

notes.title: Update Teaser - Something new on the horizon!
notes.notes:
Hey there! We’re alive and yes, we’re gearing up for an update to our little sheep-collecting game!

This update will include two new features and a bunch of squashed bugs. What kind of features, you ask? Well, we've managed to pull these images from our divinations through the Orb of Emotional Importance (with the amount of sheep collected by all of you!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41944610/79a5e4170507ca071b9432e544385d0badf05f65.png
What's this little pigeon so proud about?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41944610/2ff7e9792a08356019db6cf87a8b9f4c41311497.png
A new button on the main menu! Where does it lead, I wonder?

It seems like we've got a date for this update as well:

1st of August 2022!(GMT+8) 

The start of August is a time when pigeons express the feelings - that means we’d have to round up their emotional sheep once more! 

What kind of features do you think will be added? Feel free to speculate in the comments below and look out for their arrival in August!

Join our Community!

Get updated on our latest happenings through our social media channels, or join our Discord server and get to know us!
